steps.title: Claude can show you things
steps.body: Pictures, video, audio and files now appear in the conversation itself, under the step that made them. Nothing loads until it is near the screen, and nothing jumps as it arrives.

keys.text: files save inside the app, with progress

steps.title: Live things, right in the chat
steps.body: A YouTube video, a post, a track, or a working demo Claude wrote for you: embedded where you are reading, and safe to play with. Every embed is sandboxed.

keys.text: an ordinary link; Claude embeds it
"show me a working demo of that"

steps.title: Look closer
steps.body: Open any picture and zoom right in. Video and audio have their own players that match the app, and on a phone a video can fill and rotate the screen.

keys.text: zoom at the pointer, drag to move
on a phone, with a finger to move

steps.title: Files you can move
steps.body: Drag a file onto a folder and choose Move or Copy. Cut, copy and paste are in the right-click menu, along with everything the old buttons did. Nothing is ever overwritten.

keys.text: or press and hold, for the menu

steps.title: Type ideas where they belong
steps.body: No more dialog. A box opens in the map, right where the idea will sit. Click an idea to edit it in place; double-click for its details.

keys.text: save, or edit the selected idea

steps.title: Walk the map from the keyboard
steps.body: A ring marks where you are and glides as you move. Rearranging by drag now shows where an idea will land. The ? button in the Mindmap lists every shortcut.

keys.text: twice: the first press only warns
unfold and fold; with Ctrl, zoom

steps.title: Room to work
steps.body: Any pane can take the whole screen with one button, on a phone or a desktop. Messages now appear at the top, out of the way of what you are typing, and links have a menu of their own.

keys.text: closes what is open, not the app
